title: Vibrant Umami French Mackerel Terrine
description: A quick-fix French dish featuring mackerel, with a char-grill flavor and sugar-free friendly ingredients, formed into a terrine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, Dijon mustard, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder.
Add the chopped onion and parsley to the bowl and mix well.
Add the mackerel fillets to the bowl and coat with the marinade.
Line a terrine mold with plastic wrap, leaving some overhang for easy removal.
Arrange a layer of the mackerel mixture in the terrine mold.
Repeat the layering process until all the ingredients are used, ending with a layer of the mackerel mixture on top.
Fold the overhanging plastic wrap over the top of the terrine and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes.
Slice the terrine into serving portions and serve chilled.
